GLIMPSE.Title: Glimpse
GLIMPSE.RumourDefault: Little is known of this place. Perhaps someone has been there.

Lightbox.NothingToReveal: There is nothing to show for this location yet.

enabled.Name: Show location previews
enabled.Hint: Show a preview card when you hover a map note.

style.Name: Card style
style.Hint: The look of preview cards and the gallery.

size.Name: Card size
size.Hint: Default size of preview cards. Individual notes can override this.

excerpt.Name: Text excerpt
excerpt.Hint: How much of the journal text to show beneath the image.

textScale.Name: Text size
textScale.Hint: Scale the card text, as a percentage.

delay.Name: Hover delay
delay.Hint: Milliseconds to wait before the card appears. Moving from one note to another skips the delay.

regionMode.Name: Region banners
regionMode.Hint: Regions the GM has set up with Glimpse show a banner at the bottom of the screen.

Choices.hover: When the pointer rests in a region
Choices.key: Only while holding the Peek key (G)

slideshow.Name: Cycle through images
slideshow.Hint: When a location has several images, slowly cross-fade between them while the card is open.

motion.Name: Slow pan on images
motion.Hint: Images slowly pan while the card is open. Off by default; turned off automatically if your system asks for reduced motion.

soundVolume.Name: Ambient sound volume
soundVolume.Hint: Volume of the ambient sounds some locations play while their card is open. Set to 0 to turn them off.

travel.Name: Show travel distance
travel.Hint: Show how far a note is from your selected token, or your character's token.

hideLabel.Name: Hide note label while previewing
hideLabel.Hint: The card already shows the name of the place.

secrets.Name: Show secrets to owners
secrets.Hint: Include secret blocks in the excerpt when you own the page. Off by default, so screen-sharing stays safe.

doubleClick.Name: Double-clicking a note opens
doubleClick.Hint: The gallery shows a location's images full screen, with a button to open the journal.

Choices.gallery: The gallery, when the location has images

travelPerDay.Name: Travel per day
travelPerDay.Hint: Distance a party covers in a day, in scene units (for example 24 for miles). Set to 0 to show distance only.

nightStart.Name: Night begins at
nightStart.Hint: The in-game hour when night images take over.

nightEnd.Name: Night ends at
nightEnd.Hint: The in-game hour when day images return.

reveal.Name: Show hovered location to players
reveal.Hint: While hovering a note, show its location to everyone.

peek.Name: Peek at regions
peek.Hint: Hold to show the banner for the region under the pointer, when region banners are set to use this key.

Config.RegionIntro: Give this region a card of its own. Players see it as a banner when their pointer rests inside the region.
Config.ModeHint: Automatic shows images and text when available.
Config.SizeHint: Make this location open larger or smaller than usual, for example Cinematic for a grand vista.
Config.ImageHint: Optional image or video shown first. Visible to everyone who can see this, even if they cannot open the journal.
Config.FocusHint: Click the part of the image that must stay in view when the card crops it.
Config.FocusTooltip: Click to set the focal point
Config.NightImageHint: Shown instead during the night hours set in the module settings.
Config.Subtitle: Subtitle
Config.SubtitleHint: A short line shown above the name.
Config.FactsPlaceholder:
Population: 140
Ruled by: House Vey
Danger: Low
Config.FactsHint: One per line, as "Label: value". Shown as a row of chips under the name.
Config.SoundHint: A quiet loop that plays while the card is open.
Config.DiscoveryHint: Undiscovered places show players only a veiled image and the rumour below.

DiscoveryModes.rumour: Rumoured until the GM marks it discovered

Config.RumourHint: What players have heard about this place.
Config.VisitedHint: Players see the full card. Showing the location to players also sets this.
Config.Enabled: Show a Glimpse for this region
Config.EnabledHint: Turn on the banner for this region.
Config.EntryHint: Images and text come from this journal, as for notes.
Config.RegionTitleHint: Defaults to the page or journal name.
